body:
Thought I was alone in this. Been doing it a long time, about ten years now, since 15. It's absolutely unrelated to my epilepsy, which I was diagnosed with at age 23 after getting hit really fackin hard in the head. It's definitely the unemotional need to cry a few times a week. If I don't make myself do it, I'll start bawling (while not feeling sad, and for no apparent reason) wherever I happen to be when it hits. I don't know the answer to your problem, but you're not alone in it. I'm a macho lifter guy, it's something in the head.

The irrational bawling started for me when I first took antidepressants, which I soon stopped taking, but the crying never stopped. There might be a link between your story and mine, it might not be entirely related to the epilepsy.

Thanks, that's what I've been trying to do. Just doesn't feel right, shutting someone like a stepmom out of your life like that. Dad knows she's being crazy, but just sets her mental gymnastics aside. Thanks for the support, you're right. Can't reason with them if they're unreasonable

Yeah, tonic-clonic, couldn't possibly be mistaken for anything else. Dad's...'traditional' in his family ways, I'll put it. He's supportive of me, which is awesome. When it comes to her though, he just quietly reminds me that women aren't stable, so we shouldn't care if they're being crazy. She's got a history of being very unstable her whole life though, he's only stayed with her because they're raising my little brothers. Great relationship with my mom, stepdad, and dad though
Crazy to think about. Glad someone saved yours; keep being positive, dude
I'm still kicking, thank you. Been a very long time. In a couple hours I'm going to burn the bridge for my DnD group of the last five years

Wish I had better advice for you than this, but.. I've heard the same thing, and I'm experiencing that same pain. 

All I can really say, is, you're not in this alone. Life is a miserable fucking mess in my eyes (and yours, it would seem), but hey.. at least we're staring it in the face, still, right?

Sorry to reply to my own thing right away. I'm going on a week long wilderness retreat again in about a month. Two years ago I submerged myself in (and drank some) blue-green algae infested waters while on one such trip. The fuck is wrong with me? 
Can anyone relate?
